title: ToolMarket
tagline: Markeplace for building reputation over AI agents, and futher reputation over used agents
description: Our project allows owner of agents to expose them to regular users pay for the tool calls. The owner then register his agent in our platform, performs the registration paying in the INTMAX L2, and then we mint an NFT in Flow that refers to that AI agent. In the perspective of standard users, they can pay for request over tool calls of the agents. In this case we have some offchain MCP server that listens to payments per request events, and then it grants users access to the tool calls agents that they are using. Later on, a user can provide feedback over the used agent, like this creating some sort of reputation over the marketplace of the AI agents.
how_its_made: We have used INTMAX for the payments, Flow EVM for the storage and instantiating the AI agents, and also an offchain MCP server to keep track of payments and grant access for the user to have some tool calls he's paid for. We used vite in the client side. For the backend, we used basically Python for the MCP server, Cadence for flow smart contracts.
